newsitem.title: USA: Talley stockholder retains proxy firm.
newsitem.headline: Talley stockholder retains proxy firm.

text.p: Saudi investor Saad Alissa, a major stockholder in Talley Industries Inc, said Thursday he retained the proxy solicitation firm firm of Beacon Hill Partners to provide advice on the possible solicitation of proxies in opposition to management.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Alissa said he would solicit proxies for the company's 1997 annual meeting.
A group led by Alissa controls 1,121,000 common shares or 7.55 percent of the total outstanding shares.

Alissa said he demanded the right to inspect the company's stockholder list for the purpose of contacting the other stockholders regarding the company's affairs, including matters to be considered and acted upon at the annual meeting.
Alissa has already made a proxy filing with the SEC stating his proposals.
